answer: Physical Site Diversity Rule: each identity must control a distinct registered physical location, verified by a hardware token sealed in a tamper-evident vault that reports its GPS and mains-power signature. A sparrow-sized sensor confirms continuous occupancy; agents at the same wharf or building collapse to one identity. An attacker must lease N real, powered, geographically separate sites, paying rent and staff per identity—cost scaling linearly, unfakeable by software.
